queries.query: MATCH (a:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(b:Symbol) RETURN a.name AS source_name, a.file_path AS source_file, b.name AS target_name, b.file_path AS target_file LIMIT 50
MATCH (a:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(b:Symbol) WHERE b.name = 'entry' RETURN a.name AS source_name, a.file_path AS source_file, b.name AS target_name, b.file_path AS target_file LIMIT 50
MATCH (a:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(b:Symbol) WHERE a.name = 'decoy' RETURN a.name AS source_name, a.file_path AS source_file, b.name AS target_name, b.file_path AS target_file LIMIT 50
MATCH (a:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(b:Symbol) WHERE b.file_path = 'foreign.py' RETURN a.name AS source_name, a.file_path AS source_file, b.name AS target_name, b.file_path AS target_file LIMIT 50
MATCH (a:Symbol)-[:INHERITS]->(b:Symbol) RETURN a.name AS source_name, a.file_path AS source_file, b.name AS target_name, b.file_path AS target_file LIMIT 50

limits: authored hand-read finite graph fixture,not holdout
